{{Quote|Oh, Shannon, why aren't you at school yet? What're you doing here?''"<br/>"''My daddy forgot his lunch, so's I'm bringing it to him before I go. A bhillen sandwich — see?|A security guard to Shannon Voorson|<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />}}
'''Bhillen sandwich''' was a type of [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] made with strong smelling [[Bestinnian tang-root]] and [[bhillen]], a type of [[Species/Legends|animal]]. The [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] could be consumed by [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Human [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] and [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Shannon Voorson]] prepared a bhillen sandwich as part of a plan to run away and join her cousin [[Deen Voorson]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Shannon placed the sandwich in a [[thermabag]] along with a [[signaller]], hoping that the smell of the tang-root would discourage discovery of the communication device. When she was stopped by a [[Security guard/Legends|security guard]], she lied her way past by stating that she was delivering the sandwich to her [[Johan Voorson|father]] who had forgotten his lunch.<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Bhillen sandwich appeared in "[[Slaying Dragons]]," a [[1996]] short story written by [[Angela Phillips]] published by [[West End Games]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />
